escalation_condition: No response to verbal call or shoulder tap; abnormal, absent, or agonal breathing
approved_actions: Check responsiveness by loudly speaking and gently tapping the person's shoulders.
Look at the chest for 5 to 10 seconds to check for normal breathing movement.
If breathing normally, place them carefully into the Recovery Position (on their side) to keep airway open.
If NOT breathing or only gasping, place hands in center of chest and push hard and fast (100-120 beats/min).
Keep the airway clear by gently tilting head back and lifting chin.
critical_actions: If not breathing normally, begin continuous chest compressions.
contraindications: Do not give liquids or food to an unconscious person.
Do not shake a trauma victim vigorously.
